experiment: 15N R1, R2 and {1H}-15N NOE at 800 MHz, R2/R1 diffusion-tensor analysis
buffer: 20 mM NaH2PO4, 50 mM NaCl, 0.01% NaN3, ~8% D2O
construct_or_mutation: IsdH N2N3 (residues A326-D660) with Y642A, tri-domain N2-linker-N3
other_conditions: 1.9 mM 15N protein for R1/R2, 1.1 mM for NOE; tumbling: tau_c = 16.3 ± 0.1 ns (whole), 13.9 ± 0.1 ns (N2), 15.5 ± 0.1 ns (N3); hinge near N465-D468; related structures: 4IJ2 (Hb complex crystal)
timescale: N2 domain reorientation timescale not defined by the analysis, likely in the nanosecond range (authors' inference)
author_claim: The three domains mostly tumble as one unit, but the N2 domain has a smaller tau_c and shorter R2 values, indicating it reorients relative to the linker and N3 domains.
anchor: Regardless of the degree of flexibility at the N2-linker interface, the relaxation data strongly supports the notion that the N2 domain undergoes rearrangements that move it relative to the body of the protein.
locator: Discussion; Results, NMR relaxation measurements reveal the presence of motions between the N2 and linker domains (Table 1, Fig. S1); conditions: Methods
caveat_note: Entry is the N2 domain; relaxation was measured on the tri-domain construct. The authors state a full analysis is needed and that R2 could be inflated by chemical exchange, which would also lower tau_c. The deposit card gives 310 K and 800 MHz but no sample.

experiment: 15N-HSQC resonance assignment of N2N3(Y642A) (missing resonances) with 15N NOE and R2 (500, 600, 800 MHz instruments)
buffer: 20 mM NaH2PO4, 50 mM NaCl, 0.01% NaN3, ~8% D2O
other_conditions: regime (authors): micro- to millisecond motions; Hb-binding surface of N2 (H2 helix and strands beta4, beta6, beta7, beta8); related structures: 4IJ2
timescale: us-ms motions (inferred from unassignable, line-broadened resonances; no rate reported)
alt_state_structure: 4IJ2: Hb-bound IsdH N2N3 in which this N2 surface contacts the A and E helices of Hb (Discussion; Fig. 8)
author_claim: Resonances of the Hb-binding surface of N2 could not be assigned, which the authors attribute to us-ms fluctuations; the N3 hemin pocket is ordered.
anchor: This binding surface is unstructured and flexible in the absence of Hb, as resonances for many residues in this region are absent in the NMR spectra, presumably because they undergo micro- to milli-second motions that cause line-broadening.
locator: Discussion; Results (same section, relaxation paragraph 3); conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: Absence of peaks supports exchange broadening but does not identify the motion or its rate; the authors say 'presumably'. Disordered-to-ordered transition on Hb binding is their interpretation.

experiment: MTSL PRE (Iox/Ired) restraints with RDCs and SAXS; Ne = 4 ensemble calculation (500, 600, 800 MHz)
buffer: 20 mM NaH2PO4, 50 mM NaCl, 0.01% NaN3, ~8% D2O
ligand_or_partner: none (Hb-free); MTSL spin labels at R363C, E400C, K499C, E511C, K528C, E559C
construct_or_mutation: IsdH N2N3 (residues A326-D660) Y642A with single-cysteine MTSL variants
other_conditions: regime (authors): not stated; N2 domain positions differ by as much as ~10 Å from the average; related structures: 4IJ2 (Hb complex crystal)
alt_state_structure: 4IJ2: Hb-bound IsdH N2N3, N2 domain rotated about 30° and moved about 7 Å toward N3 compared with the apo NMR model (Results; Fig. 8)
author_claim: No single N2 orientation satisfies all PRE restraints; an ensemble of four conformers lets N2 sample positions closer to or farther from N3, with Hb-bound-like conformers infrequently populated.
anchor: The ensemble calculation reveals that in order to completely satisfy the PRE-derived distance restraint data the N2 domain can adopt positions that differ by as much as ~10 Å from its average position
locator: Discussion; Results, ensemble calculation (Fig. 7); conditions: Methods
caveat_note: Populations are described only qualitatively (a predominant narrow region plus less frequent conformers); no percentages. Ensemble size of four was chosen by agreement with data. The Methods mention four double mutants but list six cysteine sites.
